name: Kozak-2
armament: Usually a roof ring or hatch mount for a 7.62 mm PKM/PKT or 12.7 mm NSV; ATGM variant exists
protection: Steel monocoque V-hull, mine-resistant cab on an Iveco Eurocargo 4x4 chassis. Seating varies by variant (about 5-10). Game: armoured cab/hull immune to small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and larger penetrate and can disable it; any launcher destroys it.
visual_notes: Compact 4x4 armoured box on a truck chassis: short sloped bonnet, flat armoured windscreen panels, tall square passenger body
Two axles with large single off-road tyres, high ground clearance, V-shaped belly visible from the side
Rear door with small armoured window, roof hatch with weapon mount
Dimensions are for the early Kozak-2; the -2M1 is larger and heavier (check photos)
Often with anti-drone mesh and netting in 2024-2026

colour_schemes.name: Ukrainian army green with field netting
